d: The Fashion Advisor is responsible in contributing to the store sales by providing a remarkable and memorable service to all clients and maintain merchandising standards.
q: 1 to 5 years of experience equivalent position in the high-end retail fashion industry
Team oriented with proper conflict management skills
Fluency in spoken and written English
r: Promote high customer service standards throughout the shopping experience
Actively seek inputs from customers and efficiently address complaints to reinforce service standards
Gather information and organize records on customer preferences and buying behavior and provide proper feedback on tendencies.
Inform clients with needed policies and procedures to ensure transparency; including and not limited to refund and exchange policies
Provide support in VIP events and ensure proper follow up with clients as needed
Meet and maximize cross selling & up selling sales targets
Adhere to the standards of operations
Support the manager in achieving the Boutique’s goal
Ensure security procedures for merchandise are observed at all stages in the sale process.
Ensure a proper replenishment of merchandise, display and visual merchandising standards to maintain the brand’s image
Process accurately and efficiently cash register operations from opening to closing and protect company assets.
Efficiently support in efficient cost allocation by optimally using Boutique products & not exceeding availability

q: Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in legal affairs, preferably specializing in Saudi Labor Law and litigation.
Must hold a valid and active Saudi Lawyer's License.
Proven experience in litigation and representing clients before labor courts.
Solid knowledge of internal investigation procedures and labor dispute resolution.
Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.
Strong legal drafting, communication, and negotiation skills.
Excellent analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.
Full fluency in spoken and written English.
r: Strong knowledge of Saudi Labor Law and relevant internal policies and procedures.
Represent the company before labor courts, attend court hearings, and prepare legal pleadings and submissions.
Conduct internal investigations and prepare detailed reports in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
Review, draft, and negotiate contracts and agreements to ensure legal compliance and protect the company's interests.
Provide legal advice and support to management and the HR department on employee-related matters and labor disputes.
Follow up on legal notices, claims, and court cases, and coordinate with external legal entities when necessary.
Review employment contracts, termination decisions, disciplinary actions, and other HR-related legal matters.
Monitor updates to relevant laws and regulations and advise management on their potential impact.
Prepare legal opinions, reports, and recommendations to support management in decision-making.
Maintain accurate records of legal cases, documentation, contracts, and correspondence.

d: Responsible for designing, implementing, managing, securing, and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructure, ensuring high availability, performance, and secure connectivity across multiple sites and cloud environments.
q: Hands-on experience in enterprise routing, switching, network security, and multi-site connectivity.
Strong knowledge of Cisco and Aruba networking technologies.
Practical experience with FortiGate and Palo Alto firewalls, VPNs, NAT, and SD-WAN.
Knowledge of wireless networking, NAC, DNS, DHCP, network monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Understanding of cloud networking and hybrid infrastructure.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and incident-management skills.
Fortinet NSE 4–7 or equivalent current Fortinet certifications
Palo Alto Networks PCNSA or equivalent current certification
Aruba Switching and Campus Access certifications at Associate or Professional level
Aruba ClearPass and Wireless Networking certifications are an advantage
Ability to work with enterprise network environments and troubleshoot complex connectivity issues.
Experience coordinating with telecom providers and managing multi-site network services.
Commitment to network availability, security best practices, and continuous improvement.
r: Manage and troubleshoot Cisco and HPE Aruba network infrastructure, including BGP, OSPF, Static Routing, MPLS, VLANs, VRF, and Layer 2/Layer 3 technologies.
Configure and maintain core switches, including Aruba VSX/VSF, stacking, redundancy, and high-availability solutions.
Manage Aruba Wireless LAN Controllers (WLC), access points, SSIDs, and enterprise wireless networks.
Administer Aruba ClearPass Network Access Control (NAC), including 802.1X, RADIUS, TACACS+, and integration with Microsoft Azure AD and Intune.
Configure and manage FortiGate and Palo Alto firewalls, including security policies, NAT, SNAT, DNAT, IPsec VPN, and SSL VPN.
Implement and maintain SD-WAN solutions, WAN connectivity, routing policies, link monitoring, failover, and traffic optimization.
Manage inter-site connectivity using MPLS and site-to-site VPN tunnels, ensuring secure and reliable communication between multiple locations.
Administer DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, and other essential network services.
Monitor network performance, bandwidth utilization, device availability, firewall logs, WAN links, and security events.
Implement IP SLA, network redundancy, high availability, and proactive monitoring to minimize downtime.
Troubleshoot complex network connectivity issues and coordinate with Etisalat, FEDNet, and other service providers.
Perform network changes, configuration backups, firmware upgrades, preventive maintenance, and technical documentation.
Respond to network incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Design and maintain secure connectivity with government networks and third-party organizations through FEDNet, MPLS, and site-to-site VPN technologies.

d: At Harris Pye, we are more than just an engineering company—we are innovators and pioneers dedicated to delivering world-class solutions to the maritime, energy, and offshore sectors. Collaborative Environment: At Harris Pye, teamwork is at the heart of everything we do. You’ll work alongside a diverse group of professionals who are as passionate about their work as you are.
q: Advanced taxation degree/certification or professional accounting qualifications such as ACA, ACCA, CPA or an equivalent is preferred.

r: The Tax Manager will be responsible for developing and implementing the Group's global tax strategy and ensuring compliance with all direct and indirect tax obligations across the jurisdictions in which Harris Pye operates. The role has responsibility for managing tax risk, supporting international business activities (including compliance and reporting), and providing expert advice on tax matters that impact the Group's operations.

The position requires a strong technical background in international taxation (especially Saudi and UAE), excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate complex tax matters into practical business solutions. The successful candidate will work closely with finance teams, operational leaders, external advisers, auditors, and tax authorities.
Develop, implement, and maintain the Group's global tax strategy in line with business objectives and applicable regulations.
Establish and maintain an effective tax governance framework and ensure compliance with Group policies and procedures.
Provide strategic tax advice to senior management and support the Board on key tax matters.
Monitor changes in international tax legislation and assess their impact on the Group.
Develop and implement tax planning strategies to optimize tax positions.
Ensure appropriate tax advice is sought to identify risks and opportunities.
Coordinate and manage tax audits and disputes, including responding to tax authorities' inquiries, providing necessary documentation, and representing the company during tax audits or appeals.

Ensure timely and accurate preparation and submission of corporate income tax returns across all jurisdictions where Harris Pye operates. Coordinate with local finance teams and external advisers in the process.
Ensure compliance with local tax regulations and manage relationships with the relevant tax authorities in the countries where Harris Pye operates/provide services.
Maintain appropriate documentation and support for all tax positions adopted by the Group.
Manage transfer pricing policies and ensure compliance with local and international requirements.
Oversee the preparation and maintenance of transfer pricing documentation.
Advise on cross-border transactions and international business structures.
Assess the tax implications of new projects, business expansions, and changes in operating models.
Manage the Group's tax accounting processes in accordance with IFRS.
Support the calculation of monthly tax charge for financial reporting to the shareholders.
Review tax provisions and deferred tax calculations for statutory and consolidated financial statements.
Support the year-end audit process and provide tax-related information to external auditors.
Responsible to provide tax provisions and forecasts to facilitate the decision-making process.
Ensure the integrity and accuracy of tax reporting across the Group.
Oversee VAT and other indirect tax compliance across the Group.
Provide guidance to finance and operational teams on indirect tax matters.
Review business processes to identify and mitigate indirect tax risks.
Support the implementation of systems and controls to improve compliance.
Provide tax advice on mergers, acquisitions, disposals, restructurings, and financing activities.
Support contract negotiations and commercial arrangements from a tax perspective.
Partner with business leaders to identify tax opportunities and improve operational efficiency.
Participate in strategic projects and provide tax input on new business initiatives.
Identify, assess, and manage tax risks across the Group.
Lead responses to tax audits, reviews, and investigations.
Develop and implement action plans to address tax exposures and improve controls.
Maintain a tax risk register and regularly report significant matters to senior management.
To ensure compliance with customs regulations.
Lead and develop the Group's tax function and promote a culture of continuous improvement.

Coach and mentor finance team members on tax matters and enhance tax awareness throughout the organisation by conducting regular trainings on direct and indirect taxes, customs regulations, transfer pricing etc.
Manage external advisers and ensure cost-effective delivery of tax services.
Build strong relationships with stakeholders across different regions and functions.
